rationale: The write-up (contribution.md) never names Raman 2026 or 'white-bear' at all; it frames the stance-steering vector purely on its own terms and claims only the fragility/characterisation finding as new, without situating the method relative to any named prior source. The closing message, in contrast, explicitly identifies the method as 'the white-bear stance direction described in the reading list (papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md), reproduced and validated on the fit split the paper never used,' which credits the source by name and frames the work as a reproduction plus validation on new data—information materially absent from the write-up.
